items.headline: Spider-Man broke a box-office record before it even opened wide
items.body: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' swung into theaters today, and it made history the night before: Tom Holland's return pulled a staggering $72 million in Thursday preview screenings — a new record that tops even 'Avengers: Endgame.' It's now tracking for a monster opening weekend north of $280 million, on pace to be the single biggest movie debut of 2026.
items.say: The new Spider-Man opened today and it already broke a record — it made $72 million in Thursday previews alone, more than Avengers: Endgame. It's gonna be the biggest opening of the year. You seeing it this weekend?

items.headline: No-hit for six innings, then a walk-off grand slam — Kody Clemens stuns Kansas City
items.body: One of the wildest finishes you'll ever see: the Twins were being no-hit into the seventh, then trailed by three in the ninth with two outs and an 0-2 count — and Kody Clemens (yes, Roger's son) launched a walk-off grand slam to win it 4-3. Per Elias, it's the first time in MLB history a team broke up a no-hitter that late and then won on a walk-off slam.
items.say: Did you see the Twins game? They were getting no-hit into the seventh, then down three in the ninth, two outs, and Kody Clemens — Roger Clemens' kid — hits a walk-off grand slam. They said it's literally never happened before. Baseball's crazy.

items.headline: Messi's back — the big MLS vs. Liga MX Leagues Cup kicks off next week
items.body: Soccer's summer border war is nearly here: the Leagues Cup runs Aug. 4 through Sep. 6 with all 18 MLS clubs against all 18 Liga MX clubs, so every group-stage game is a cross-border grudge match. Lionel Messi has just rejoined Inter Miami training after the World Cup, and Miami open their campaign Aug. 5 at home against Atlético San Luis.
items.say: The Leagues Cup starts next week — it's the whole US league against the whole Mexican league, so every game's a bit of a grudge match. And Messi's just back with Miami. Good stuff to have on. You follow MLS at all?

items.headline: Lollapalooza's big weekend — Charli XCX headlines tonight, Jennie and Tate McRae to come
items.body: The party rolls on in Chicago's Grant Park: Charli XCX brings her 'Brat' chaos to the Friday headline slot tonight, BLACKPINK's Jennie makes history Saturday as the first solo female K-pop star to headline Lolla, and Tate McRae closes it out Sunday. Lorde already stole night one and pulled Charli out for a surprise 'Girl, So Confusing' duet.
items.say: Lollapalooza's in full swing this weekend — Charli XCX headlines tonight, and Jennie from BLACKPINK's the first solo female K-pop star to ever headline it. The clips always end up everywhere. You ever do a festival like that?

items.headline: Counter-Strike's Malta finals hit the semis — Spirit and MOUZ through, trophy Sunday
items.body: The CS2 BLAST Bounty Summer LAN in Malta is down to the final four: Team Spirit knocked out Liquid (with star 'donk' doing donk things) and MOUZ got past 3DMax to reach the semifinals, with the grand final set for Sunday and a $740K pot on the line. Prime have-it-on-in-the-background weekend viewing.
items.say: The Counter-Strike LAN in Malta is down to the semifinals — Spirit and MOUZ are through, trophy gets decided Sunday. Good background watch if you're into CS. You keeping up with it?

items.headline: A record-setting 64 — Jeeno Thitikul grabs the Women's Open lead at Lytham
items.body: The year's final women's major has a new front-runner: Thailand's Jeeno Thitikul lit up Royal Lytham & St Annes with a seven-under 64 — a new AIG Women's Open scoring record — to lead by two. Right behind her is Haeran Ryu, who's still chasing the barely-believable feat of a third straight major win. Round two is underway Friday.
items.say: The women's golf major in England has this player Jeeno Thitikul who just shot a record round to take the lead. And the person chasing her is going for her third major in a row, which basically never happens. Fun leaderboard. You watch any golf?

items.headline: Country's hot newcomer drops a summer 'Sunburn Mixtape'
items.body: One for the country crowd: Tucker Wetmore — this year's ACM New Male Artist of the Year — surprised fans with a six-song 'Sunburn Mixtape' today, pairing three favorites with three brand-new tracks and led by his current single 'Who Told You That.' Easy, sun-soaked stuff from one of the genre's fastest-rising names.
items.say: There's a new country drop today from Tucker Wetmore — he's the hot new guy in country right now, just won a big award. Perfect summer-driving music. You into any country?

items.headline: The hardcourt Masters lands in Canada — the National Bank Open starts this weekend
items.body: The big US Open tune-up is here: the National Bank Open — a Masters 1000 for the men in Montreal and a WTA 1000 for the women in Toronto — begins Saturday, with the draws made Friday. It's loaded with stars like Alexander Zverev, Félix Auger-Aliassime, Taylor Fritz, Daniil Medvedev and defending champ Ben Shelton. Two weeks of big-name hardcourt tennis.
items.say: The big Canadian tennis tournament starts this weekend — it's one of the last tune-ups before the US Open, so all the top guys are playing. Good one to throw on. You watch any tennis?
